notes.title: Major update Trials of Gods arrived! Come and conquer the final chapter
notes.content:
Hey Warriors,

Thank you for your patience, the major update we promised has finally arrived!

This major update is called [b]Trials of Gods[/b], including new hero morhps, new levels, new boss and new challenges. It's definitely the biggest update since Warriors of the Nile launched, we hope the new content could bring more fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283587/61b7eefc2b18459a7ae6782a7015323776726bde.png[/img]

What we have to remind you is, the fourth chapter and new trials will bring you the toughest challenge so far. Can you beat it?

[b]Update log v1.0304[/b]
[list]
[*] 6 new hero morphs
[*] Final chapter added (accessible with final trial)
[*] New enemies including powerful new boss
[*] Trials of Gods, different from previous challenge
[*] New achievements added
[/list]

Please let us know via Steam forum or Discord if you encounter any bugs or problems.


Stove Studio

tags.feature: Final chapter added (accessible with final trial)
New enemies including powerful new boss
Trials of Gods, different from previous challenge

notes.title: Major Update is coming next month, and we're heading to TGS!
notes.content:
Hello warriors,

Warriors of the Nile has launched for more than a month, and two weeks have passed since the last Steam news. But don't be worried, we are keep making new content. Now we guess it's time to share some news with you guys.

The next major update is coming in October, including:
[list]
[*] Two brand new Nile squads, each contains three new morphs
[*] New challenges different from existing challenge levels
[*] A new boss battle
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283587/ffc8332ebf7c3819fcc629f74a1c61297dbc8f7b.png[/img]

By the way, we're heading to Tokyo Game Show which will take place next week!

On 12pm Sep 25th JST, our publisher Gamera Game will hold a special live streaming. Warriors of the Nile will be part of the show, you can expect some world premier contents. It's a really special moment for us, and we hope to witness it with you!

See you next week.


Stove Studio

tags.feature: Two brand new Nile squads, each contains three new morphs
New challenges different from existing challenge levels

notes.title: Update log v1.0202. New content is coming
notes.content:
After fixing tons of bugs at launch, this time we spent a little longer time bringing you some brand new content of Warriors of the Nile. These include new carvings and gears. In addition a new hero morph Yu Qing, which designed by the player '梦回仙灵' who won the Demo Speedrun conpetition, officially joined the warriors squad.

[b]Update log v1.0202[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 5 new carvings
[*] Added 6 new gears
[*] Adjusted the layout of hero morph interface and added detailed information of warriors
[*] Added new archer hero morph Yu Qing
[*] Fixed bug that gears can be equipped even if the gear type does not match slot
[*] Now you can check detailed information of tablets on history record interface
[/list]

notes.title: Update log v1.0101 - Gears can be sold now
notes.content:
It has been almost two weeks after Warriors of the Nile launched. Apophis has been defeated by Warriors for countless times. We just want to say thanks again to everyone of you who has endured and reported bugs to us.

[b]In the latest update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now you can sell gears to trader for money
[*] Golds have new uses - to refresh gears from trader
[*] Finally you can check gears collection in your citadel
[*] Of course, some bugs are fixed
[/list]

[b]What will happen later:[/b]
[list]
[*] New hero morphs and collaboration content is scheduled to be out in September, maybe more than you expect
[*] We will attend PAX Online
[*] And more are coming...
[/list]

Well, you know that new features always mean new bu...so don't hesitate to tell us when you found any problems!


Stove Studio

[b][h3]About Set Sarcophagus bug[/h3][/b]
In level 2-9, occasionally Set Sarcophagus won't swtich forms that causes game can not be proceeded.
This is the most serious bug at this point, we're doing our best to fix it asap. If you encounter this bug, please exit and restart the game. The progress will return to the beginning of level 2-9.

Also you could report problems or tell us your feedback through discussion thread of [url=https://discord.gg/uykMdxD]Discord channel[/url]. 

Thank you all for support.
